北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大天冷，体感-10℃！注意防风保暖哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is windy and cold, -10℃! Remember to keep warm.
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 6级

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪风力不小，体感 9℃。早晚温差大，别着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is breezy, feels like 9℃. Mind the temperature difference.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阳光正好，体感 9℃。出门记得享受阳光。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has lovely sunshine, feels like 9℃. Enjoy the warmth.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州气温舒适 20℃，微风和煦。好好享受好天气！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is pleasant at 20℃ with a gentle breeze. Enjoy the day!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴好 20℃，体感舒适。别忘了补充水分哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny 20℃ and comfy. Don't forget to hydrate.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州风力 6级，体感降至 6℃。风大体感凉，多穿点。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is windy (level 6), feels like 6℃. Dress warmly.
杭州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 6级

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天微冷，体感 4℃。出门别忘添衣，注意防风。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and cool, feels like 4℃. Add layers and mind the wind.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，气温 13℃，体感舒适。外出记得带外套。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy 13℃, feels comfy. Bring a jacket if you go out.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉风力 6级，体感只有 6℃。风寒效应强，穿暖和点。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is windy (level 6), feels like 6℃. Dress warmly to beat the chill.
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 6级

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴好，体感 4℃。湿度很低，注意补水保湿哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, feels like 4℃. Very dry, remember to hydrate.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，气温 12℃。出门记得戴口罩，注意防护。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has haze, 12℃. Wear a mask when going out for protection.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感-24℃！极度寒冷，全副武装才能出门。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -24℃! Extremely cold, bundle up completely!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感-16℃。天气寒冷，注意添衣保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and cold, feels like -16℃. Dress warmly.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云 14℃，体感 10℃。早晚温差大，记得添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy 14℃, feels like 10℃. Mind the temperature difference.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴好，体感 14℃。享受阳光，别忘了防晒哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, feels like 14℃. Enjoy the sun, but don't forget sunscreen.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风力 6级，体感-7℃。外出务必注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is windy (level 6), feels like -7℃. Dress warmly against the wind.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连风力 6级，体感-14℃。出门一定要多穿点。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is windy (level 6), feels like -14℃. Bundle up before going out.
